sources.title: Cloudflare incident on June 20, 2024
sources.key_facts: Incident start 17:47 UTC, end 19:27 UTC, duration 100 min (17:47→19:27). DDoS rule deployed 14:14-17:06 UTC. Peak CDN error rate 2.1%, peak 5xx 3.45%, TTFB P99 3x normal. Western Europe capacity loss 10%, Eastern Europe 4%. Backbone congestion window 17:33-17:50 UTC. Traffic Manager bug first triggered 18:17 UTC. DDoS rule disabled 19:34 UTC. Buggy Lua functions: get_cookie_key(), has_valid_cookie_broken(), parent_key_generator() (self-referencing via tail call). Two independent causal chains: (1) DDoS rule + Lua infinite loop, (2) backbone congestion triggering Traffic Manager latent bug.

sources.title: Cloudflare incident on October 30, 2023
sources.key_facts: Impact start 2023-10-30T19:54:00Z, end 2023-10-30T20:31:00Z, duration 37 minutes. Root cause: deployment tool bug returned staging build GUID mixed with production releases. Affected 11 services: Workers KV, Pages, Access, WARP, Images API, Cache Purge, Workers dashboard, AI Gateway, Waiting Room, Turnstile, Cloudflare Dashboard. HTTP 401 errors from KV, HTTP 500 from Pages. Resolved via break-glass mechanism bypassing normal tooling. 5 corrective actions prioritized for the quarter.

sources.title: Thanksgiving 2023 Security Incident
sources.key_facts: Attack window November 14-24, 2023. Initial access via Atlassian at 2023-11-15T16:28:38Z. Detection at 2023-11-23T16:00Z. Threat actor accessed 36 Jira tickets (of 2.06M), 202 Confluence pages (of 194.1K), downloaded 76 of 11.9K Bitbucket repositories. Root cause: failure to rotate credentials after October 2023 Okta breach. Attacker installed Sliver C2 framework. Remediation: rotated 5000+ production credentials, forensic triage of 4893 systems, reimaged all global network machines.

sources.title: Cloudflare incident on November 14, 2024 — Lost Logs
sources.key_facts: Duration approximately 3.5 hours. ~55% of logs normally sent to customers were lost. Scale: 4.5 trillion logs sent daily. Buffer count increased from ~1 million to ~40 million globally (40x). Root cause: blank Logfwdr configuration + failsafe misconfiguration caused log routing to all customers instead of configured Logpush subscribers + Buftee buffer system protective mechanisms not activated.

sources.title: Cloudflare Business Service Level Agreement
sources.key_facts: SLA uptime commitment: 100%. Credit formula: Service Credit = (Outage Period minutes * Affected Customer Ratio) / Scheduled Availability minutes. Affected Customer Ratio = unique IPs affected / total unique IPs. Claims must be submitted within 5 business days of incident. Maximum annual credits cannot exceed one month cumulative service fees. SLA excludes issues outside Cloudflare's reasonable control.

sources.title: GitHub Availability Report: April 2024
sources.key_facts: Incident 1: 2024-04-05T08:11Z-08:58Z (47 min), DB load balancer change caused connection failures, web errors peaked 6%, API errors 10%, 100,000+ Actions workflows failed. Incident 2: 2024-04-10T08:18Z (120 min), unbounded query overloaded primary DB, 17% failure rate for web file editing. Incident 3: 2024-04-10T18:33Z-19:03Z (30 min), compute-intensive DB query, 100% GitHub Pages deployment failures.

sources.title: GitHub Availability Report: August 2024
sources.key_facts: Incident: 2024-08-14T23:02Z-23:38Z, duration 36 minutes. Root cause: erroneous configuration change to GitHub.com databases impacted health check pings from routing service, making production read-only DB endpoint inaccessible. All GitHub services inaccessible for all users. No data loss or corruption. Resolved by reverting config change.
